The files in this folder are from the jackpal/gateway project (https://github.com/jackpal/gateway) and are licensed with the BSD 3-Clause license. The files used are unmodified (from the `route-tables/` folder) and only used as input data for unit tests.

- `freeBSD.txt`: `netstat -rn` on FreeBSD (AWS, `ena0`)
- `freeBSDNoRoute.txt`: `netstat -rn` on FreeBSD with no default route
